description: The digest of the value of every row of the records of the table of what the instance does (src/parity/records/), by axis, as they were recorded on the published version (the records of commit 00426fa7). scripts/gates/parity-records.mjs compares the records with them: a row whose value is not the one of its digest has a mark in src/parity/marks.json, and no row of this list is removed from the records. Only the maintainer changes it.
